project_context.core_problem: The QuickFlexyPanel was squeezed into a narrow middle column, causing vertical stacking of amount buttons. The layout lacks responsiveness across mobile and tablet.

archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Soft Utility POS

font_family.headings: Tajawal, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, or Cairo (Strong, legible Arabic sans-serif)

layout_strategy.global_grid: The POS should move from a rigid 3-column flex layout to a responsive 12-column CSS Grid.

desktop_1920.description: Sidebar on Right (RTL). Main area split into 2 primary zones.
desktop_1920.container_classes: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 h-screen overflow-hidden p-4
desktop_1920.cart_area: lg:col-span-4 xl:col-span-3 flex flex-col h-full bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200
desktop_1920.actions_area: lg:col-span-8 xl:col-span-9 flex flex-col gap-6 h-full overflow-y-auto

QuickFlexyPanel.issue: Previously squeezed in an 80px wide vertical column.
QuickFlexyPanel.solution: Place it inside the main 'Actions Area' (the 8-col section) as a full-width horizontal card.

interactive_elements.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height for all buttons and inputs (mobile-friendly). Use 56px (h-14) or 64px (h-16) for primary POS grid actions.
interactive_elements.active_states: Use transform active:scale-95 for tactile feedback on touch devices.
interactive_elements.testing: Ensure every button has a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='flexy-amount-500').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the existing 3-column flex layout with a 12-column CSS grid (`grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6`).
2. Move the Cart/Checkout section to the right-most side (or left depending on exact RTL mirroring preference, usually `col-span-4`).
3. Combine the previous 'left task column' and 'middle flexy column' into a single 'Actions Area' (`col-span-8`).
4. Inside the Actions Area, render the QuickFlexyPanel as a full-width block (`w-full flex-col`).
5. Change the QuickFlexyPanel amount buttons container to `grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-3` to fix the vertical squeezing issue.
6. Ensure all UI components use Tailwind classes mapped to the 'colors' and 'typography' definitions above.
7. Implement a Bottom Sheet or toggle for the Cart on mobile screens (`max-w-md` breakpoints) so the Actions Area takes full width on phones.
8. Add `dir="rtl"` to the root POS container if not already present globally.
9. Do NOT modify backend logic or component state—only adjust the Tailwind classes and JSX structure to achieve this grid redesign.
